title: Canto 10: Summum Bonum - Title, Artist and Source Pictures Canto 10
content:
Title, Artist and Source Pictures Canto 10

(up to ch. 68)

10.1

Title: ‘The Story of Krishna’s birth’, page from the tenth book of the Bhāgavata Purāṇa.​
Source: Ackland Museum of Art, ackland.org

10.2

Title: The two images to the right and the left are both details from a painting titled: ‘The Gods in Vishnu’s heaven with Vishnu sitting enthroned on a heap of lotus petals’, Punjab Hills (India), 1745-1754.

Source: © Victoria & Albert Museum

10.3

Title: (computer enhanced) Image of Vasudeva with Krishna escaping from prison.

Artist: Raja Ravi Varma

Source: Wikipedia.org

10.4

Title: “Kamsa māyā”

Artist: Raja Ravi Varma

Source: wikipedia.org

10.5

Title: “Rao Ram Singh I of Kota Plays Nanda”.

Style: Possibly a page from a dispersed series of the Bhāgavata Purāṇa (Story of Lord Vishnu). Made in Kota ca. 1700, Rajasthan, India.

Source: Internet. Philadelphia Museum of Art

10.6

Title: The (computer enhanced) painting of Pūtanā is a Rajasthani painting. India, Punjab Hills, Kangra or Guler(?), 18th century.

Source: Ackland Museum of Art, ackland.org

10.7

Title: “Krishna Kills the Tornado Demon Trinavarta”.

Style: Folio from a Bhāgavata Purāṇa (Ancient Stories of the Lord), India, Gujarat, c. 1625-1650.

Source: Los Angeles County Museum of Art (LACMA), collectionsonline.lacma.org

10.8

Title: Detail “Maharao Shatru Sal I of Kota and Courtiers Celebrate Krishna’s Birthday”.

Style: Made in Kota, Rajasthan, India, 1764.

Source: Internet. Philadelphia Museum of Art.

10.9

Title: Rajasthani painting of Krishna Lila

Source: Internet. geocities.com

10.10

Title: “Krishna Splits the Double Arjuna Tree”.

Style: Page from a dispersed series of the Bhāgavata Purāṇa, made in Surat, Gujarat, India, ca. 1720

Source: Internet, Philadelphia Museum of Art

10.11

Title: Fruit vendor

Artist: B.K. Mitra

Source: Collectie van Gita Press, Gorakhpur

Title: “Krishna Destroys the Demon Agha”.
